# go-modern-bytes-cut

**Since:** Go 1.18

## Summary

Use bytes.Cut instead of bytes.Index plus manual slicing.

## Details

bytes.Cut returns before, after, and found in one call.
It avoids duplicated Index checks and separator-length arithmetic while returning slices of the original byte slice.

## Examples

### Before

```go
i := bytes.Index(b, sep)
if i < 0 {
  return nil, nil, false
}
before, after := b[:i], b[i+len(sep):]
```

### After

```go
before, after, found := bytes.Cut(b, sep)
```
